findings.claim: ShellLayout now routes find's tab requests through a new `tabRequest` state, and makes the desktop InspectorShell controlled (`activeId`/`onActiveIdChange`) on every page. That includes player files and the MarkdownDocumentLayout, which the touch points say stay unchanged.
findings.impact: Tab selection on player files, Markdown and HTML pages now goes through new lifted state: a reset key built from fileId, phone/desktop and open/closed, and a request counter. A selection regression on those pages would fall outside the planned scope.
findings.evidence: ShellLayout.tsx:366-377 replaces `selectRequest={find.selectRequest}` with `tabRequest`. Lines 597-642 add `desktopShellKey`, `desktopWanted` and `activeId={desktopActiveId ?? 'info'}`, built unconditionally. Line 732 passes the same `inspector` to MarkdownDocumentLayout. The phone sheet's InspectorShell at line 654 also takes `tabRequest`.

bucket_proposal.reason: The touch points say 'The Markdown path unchanged' and 'Player files: unchanged', but their inspector selection was rewritten. No declared invariant is shown broken.

findings.proposed_fix: Either scope the controlled selection to files without a player, or state in the touch points that every file page's inspector selection is now lifted into ShellLayout.

findings.claim: On a player file, Info's exclusion of `detailed-summary` changed. It used to be a hard-coded core exclusion. Now it holds only when a `player-side` entry has the same id. The touch-point list does not name this player-file change.
findings.impact: With the real intelligence manifest, `detailed-summary` stays out of Info on a player file because it is also in `player-side`, so I9 holds. If an add-on registers `detailed-summary` only in `file-detail-sections`, Info on a player file now draws it. Three existing tests had to claim `player-side` to keep passing.
findings.evidence: ShellLayout.tsx:457-465: for `usesCanvasViewer` (player files included), `canvasSlotIds` is `documentSideEntries.map(...)`, which is `[]` when `hasPlayer`. The base used `['detailed-summary']`. MediaShell.test.tsx:1316-1318 and FileDetailContent.test.tsx:572-579 add a `player-side` claim. FileDetailContent.test.tsx:221-223 changes a slot count from 4 to 3.
findings.repro: Mutation: drop the `player-side` claim added at MediaShell.test.tsx:1316. Read from the code: the 'keeps an addon section the canvas does not draw' expectation of an exclude list containing detailed-summary would no longer hold. Not run.

bucket_proposal.reason: I9 holds with the shipped manifest. The player-file exclusion rule changed without a touch point.

findings.proposed_fix: Add the player-file exclusion change to the ShellLayout touch point and to the ADDON-DEVELOPMENT `file-detail-sections` row, or keep `detailed-summary` excluded on player files.

findings.claim: DetailedSummarySection's `canShow` no longer counts an active summary note. This changes the availability the same component reports in `player-side` on player files. The touch point names only `openInViewer`, `select()` and `active`.
findings.impact: On a video with an active summary note and no generated detailed summary, the Detailed summary panel and narrow-form tab used to be listed, though the body drew nothing. They are now unlisted. Arguably a fix, but it reaches player files, which the touch points say stay unchanged.
findings.evidence: addons/intelligence/frontend/DetailedSummarySection.tsx:190-194 removes `hasActiveSummary ||` from `canShow`. Lines 247-250 report `canShow` through `onAvailability` in every slot. The same component is registered in `player-side` (WorkbenchManifest.test.ts asserts `ids('player-side')` contains detailed-summary).

bucket_proposal.reason: An unplanned change to player-side availability. I13 covers only the document-side tab.

findings.proposed_fix: List the `canShow` change in the add-on touch point, including its effect on the player-side panel.

findings.claim: `doRegenerate` now sets the status to generating early, reports available and calls `select()` on every regenerate path: Retry, regenerate from the body, the confirmed regenerate, and player-side mounts. The touch point says only 'call select() when its AI-menu action starts generation'.
findings.impact: A Retry or regenerate pressed inside the tab also re-requests the tab. On a phone it raises the sheet to half when the sheet sits lower. Local `data` gets a synthetic `status: 'generating'` before the server answers.
findings.evidence: DetailedSummarySection.tsx:304-313 sets the early status, calls `onAvailabilityRef.current?.(true)` and `selectRef.current?.()` unconditionally inside `doRegenerate`. Its callers are `handleGenerate` (AI menu and Retry) and `handleConfirmRegenerate`.

bucket_proposal.reason: Wider than the planned touch point. No invariant is shown broken.

findings.proposed_fix: Name the actual scope (every regenerate start) in the touch point, or call select() only from the AI-menu run.

findings.claim: I11 fails when an active summary note exists: 'Create detailed summary' from the AI menu opens a confirm dialog that is never rendered. Nothing is generated and no tab is listed or selected.
findings.impact: A reader on a PDF with a summary note clicks AI → Create detailed summary and nothing happens. The action fails silently.
findings.evidence: DetailedSummarySection.tsx:494-501 offers the AI action whenever `!data.available` and the status is neither generating nor failed. `startGenerate` (344-348) sets `confirmRegenerateOpen` when `hasActiveSummary`. The ConfirmDialog renders only inside DetailedSummaryBody (925-926), which is reached only when `data.available` (575 returns null otherwise). `doRegenerate`, and with it `select()`, is never called.
findings.repro: not_reproduced (traced in code: an active note plus reason 'not_generated' leads to setConfirmRegenerateOpen(true) and the component returning null)

bucket_proposal.reason: I11 requires the tab listed and selected after starting from the AI button. The add-on test DetailedSummaryDocumentSide.test.tsx covers only the no-note case.

findings.proposed_fix: Render the confirm dialog outside the available-only body, or skip the confirmation when no detailed summary exists yet.
